title: Architectural Stair Glitch — hard daylight, low angles, reflective editorial inserts

palette.name: muted structural green
palette.role: minor environmental neutral only, never source-product authority

unknowns: focal lengths, aperture, shutter angle and camera make
exact bridge and stair location and physical dimensions
lighting fixture count; only hard directional daylight consequences are visible
post-production software and exact glitch transition recipe

runtime_style.visual_system: A vertical fashion edit moves from a pale concrete pedestrian bridge into an exposed stair structure, repeatedly dropping the camera to tread and waist level and punctuating live action with reflective product inserts and short digital glitches.
runtime_style.mood_line: Controlled urban confidence interrupted by cold, graphic editorial flashes.
runtime_style.environment: One coherent exterior concrete bridge and stair complex with pale slabs, dark metal rails, open blue sky, hard-edged daylight and deep under-stair shadow; reflective inserts are editorial interludes, not replacement locations.
runtime_style.lighting: Hard directional daylight with crisp edge separation, bright concrete, cool open-sky fill and retained blue-black shadow; reflective inserts shift toward lavender without warming the physical location.
materials: approved garment and approved item only
runtime_style.contrast: Firm contrast with clean concrete highlights, dense but readable under-stair blacks, cool blue and lavender accents, and no warm cinematic wash.
runtime_style.expression_signature: The approved face stays composed and self-possessed: gaze follows travel or passes just beyond lens, mouth relaxed and closed, no smile performance and no source-face transfer.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Preserve only movement response: approved clothing reacts to stride, descent and low-angle body turns with crisp hard-light edges; never copy the source outfit, colour, silhouette, pattern or branding.
optical_signature: Alternation between compressed bridge coverage and extreme low architectural perspective
Crisp hard-light edges with occasional deliberate motion smear
Brief monochrome, reflective lavender and digital split/glitch punctuation
Connected-body item details rather than passport framing or detached flat lays

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Use the closer bridge profile at upper-torso to near-full-body scale with long rail lines behind and hard daylight preserving the approved face.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Advance through a natural lateral stride, head aligned with travel, shoulders quiet and arms counter-swinging without turning into a front-facing portrait.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Hold the approved face, hairline and upper approved garment sharp while rail depth remains clearly architectural.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: Keep the identity frame free of heavy occlusion; no white studio or avatar-reference background may appear.
provenance: frame-002 profile bridge coverage and frame-001 lateral travel

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Use a wide vertical bridge view with the full approved look small against pale concrete, dark rails and open sky.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Take a complete readable stride with both legs and footwear visible and weight clearly transferring forward.
environmental_hero.focus: Keep person and immediate bridge plane crisp while the repeating architecture carries depth.
environmental_hero.foreground: Rails may frame but do not cover the approved face, item identity or footwear.
provenance: frame-001 distant bridge walk and frame-004 stair-top spatial reset

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Place the camera close to the stair plane and point steeply upward so rails converge around the approved body against blue sky.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Hold a planted lower foot, bent advancing knee, rotated torso and long neck, maintaining balance rather than fashion-pose distortion.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Prioritise the approved face, torso and leading garment edges; retain hard concrete boundaries.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: A stair edge may occupy the lowest strip but cannot sever the body or hide the approved item.
provenance: frame-014 stair push and frame-015 extreme low sky angle

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Shoot through the underside of a stair or diagonal rail so architecture becomes a deliberate near-plane mask while motion remains visible behind it.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Continue the descent with leading foot finding the next tread and torso following; do not freeze into a passport stance.
interference_frame.focus: Let one rail edge become dominant while the approved face or full item remains readable in a secondary clear zone.
interference_frame.foreground: Concrete and metal are the only occluders; no invented props, people or avatar-reference backgrounds.
provenance: frame-006 tread-level descent and frame-007 rail/underside occlusion

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Use an extreme low waist-to-hand connected-body crop, retaining torso, hand and approved garment context around the approved item.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Keep the item-bearing hand connected to forearm and shoulder while the hips continue through a step or turn.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Lock exact approved item construction, colour, material, hardware, logo and text; allow body edges to fall slightly subordinate.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The approved item owns the near plane; the source green plush object and source branding are forbidden.
provenance: frame-008 waist/item close-up and frame-016 final connected accessory close

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Resolve with a brief reflective product montage and then a near-black end-card beat, preserving the reference timing but replacing its content.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: When a performer fragment is used, keep it connected to the prior action; product-only frames contain no invented performer.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Render the approved item sharply through reflective lavender layers before a clean black hold.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: Glitch fragments may split the frame but must not duplicate the person or create a second item design.
provenance: frame-012 product insert, frame-013 glitch montage and frame-017 end-card timing

Carry palette hex #040809 #182229 #5D605F #DEE4E7 #50709D #E6D9F5 #908BAA #89788E #546B5E. No invented metadata.
